changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Type') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[Type]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [PublishedVersionID] [int] NULL, [Deleted] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_WorkflowType_Deleted] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_WorkflowType_State] DEFAULT (-1) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_workflow_Type_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_WorkflowType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
